subject: Lighthouse: milestone plan, procurement constraints & pricing approval request
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@lighthouseanalytics.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call recap + draft milestone plan (MAP)

Hi Samir — thanks for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery call and the attached draft milestone plan (Lighthouse_MAP_v1.xlsx). I flagged the items we discussed under "Dependencies" and added owner suggestions. High-level: 

- Goal: integrate Redwood Hosted + Dedicated for prod inference (search reranking + summary generation)
- Target pilot: 6-week PoC starting early Dec; target pilot close: 2026-12-23
- Estimated commit (for pricing): $500k ARR preferred, will discuss structure in the MAP

Open items / asks for your team: 
- Can you confirm data residency requirement (single-region vs multi-region)? (Jill)
- Procurement timeline and required legal inserts — you mentioned finance needs a 30-day review window
- Any SOC2 evidence required up-front? I attached a short procurement_constraints.pdf you referenced.

Next steps I own: attach MAP v1 and will update milestones after your feedback. If the milestones look good, we usually build a one-page mutual action plan with clear owners, target dates, and gating criteria — I put a first draft in the spreadsheet.

Attachments: Lighthouse_MAP_v1.xlsx; procurement_constraints.pdf

Thanks,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
https://redwood.com

---
From: Samir Patel <samir@lighthouseanalytics.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jill Carter <jill.carter@lighthouseanalytics.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 09:06:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + draft milestone plan (MAP)

Hannah — thanks for the clear recap and the draft. A few notes from our side: 

1) Procurement: finance will need the SOC2 report and vendor security questionnaire answered before the contract review. The procurement_constraints.pdf you attached is helpful; please include a one-page security checklist we can share with legal.

2) Timeline: We can aim for a pilot start the week of Dec 6, but procurement + legal will likely push formal sign-off to the week of Dec 27 if everything is standard. We need a short commercial runway for Q1 budget planning.

3) Pricing ask: We are excited about the product but need a promotional credit or stepped pricing in the first 6 months to offset integration costs. Can Redwood provide a platform credit or a discounted entry tier? We are targeting a $500k commit if pricing incentivizes the pilot.

I attached our internal procurement note (procurement_constraints.pdf) with the key dates. Also, please confirm the milestones and owners — I want the internal RACI for the pilot (we'll assign engineering and data steward after procurement).

Thanks — Samir
Samir Patel
CTO, Lighthouse Analytics
---
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 11:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Lighthouse MAP draft — pricing approval request (LD-4821)

Team — looping in because Samir explicitly requested a promotional credit/discount tied to a $500k commit. Attached is a quick pricing calc (pricing_calc_LD-4821.xlsx) with two options:

Option A (aggressive): 20% discount + $50k platform credit applied over first 6 months (requires Senior AE sign-off + Revenue OPS approval)
Option B (standard): 15% discount, no upfront credit (requires Sales Director sign-off)

Business rationale: Option A materially accelerates conversion and increases expected ARR; Lighthouse is a mid-market prospect with strategic analytics use case and potential to scale across their customer base.

Request: can we get exec approval for Option A? If not, what's the earliest approval path for Option B? Also confirm whether we should move the pilot close target to 2026-12-23 or leave as Dec 31 to align with finance.

Attachments: pricing_calc_LD-4821.xlsx

-Aditya
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
---
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Lighthouse MAP draft — pricing approval request (LD-4821)

Aditya / Hannah — reviewed. I support moving quickly but want to limit downside. My decision: approve Option B (15% discount, no upfront platform credit) at the Director level. Option A (20% + $50k credit) requires VP of Sales approval and a clear commit (minimum $500k ARR contract signed within 60 days of pilot completion).

Please prepare a one-page business justification for the credit (expected lift, reference customers, churn assumptions). We need that before I take up to VP. Also include a proposed repayment/fallback if milestones miss (e.g., scaled credit recoup over 12 months).

Next steps for the AE: Hannah, finalize the revised MAP with the updated milestone dates and RACI, and capture Samir's procurement timeline. I'll route Option A for VP approval if you submit the justification AND get Samir to commit to the $500k headline in writing.

Related: HubSpot deal link HS-4821 contains the forecast and target ARR.

-Marissa
Director, Sales — Enterprise
Redwood Inference

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@lighthouseanalytics.com>, Jill Carter <jill.carter@lighthouseanalytics.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 09:28:00 -0800
Subject: Updated milestone plan & next steps — pricing in exec review (LD-4821)

Hi Samir / Jill — attached is the updated mutual action plan (Lighthouse_MAP_v2.xlsx) with revised milestones, owners, and gating criteria. Summary of the key changes: 

- Pilot Start: target week of 2026-12-06 (engineering onboarding & dataset ingestion)
- Pilot Acceptance Criteria: PSD > 0.85 on reranking benchmark; data pipeline validated by their data steward
- Owner changes: Redwood SE (Aditya) owns model integration; Lighthouse data steward (TBD) owns validation checks
- Procurement dependency: SOC2 evidence must be delivered before contract execution; procurement expects a 2–3 week review window after final SOW

Pricing update: Marissa approved Option B (15% discount, no initial credit) at Director level. We are preparing a one-page business justification to request Option A (20% + $50k credit) to route to VP for final approval. I will share that to you by EOD Mon 11/16 if you confirm the $500k headline commit language.

Can you confirm by Tue 11/17 whether Lighthouse can commit to the $500k headline (not a signed contract yet) as a sales signal for exec review? Once we have that, I'll escalate the business justification to Marissa for VP review.

Attachments: Lighthouse_MAP_v2.xlsx

Thanks again — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
